about: Collectible artifacts. To add one: add an entry to artifacts and give it a collection id from collections. rarity: common, rare, epic or legendary (it drops from boxes of that rarity). symbol: an SF Symbol name shown until you drop an image named artifact.<id>.png into App/Ledger/Resources/Content/art. A collection is complete when the player owns every artifact that names it; reward is the id of a cosmetic in Content/cosmetics/gold_cosmetics.json with source collection.
